name: cost_sheet
description: The live price list for pricing work: what a research run has cost on each model tier, a Steward pass on each tier, a request's scoping pass, and the paid tools' per-call and per-word charges, from the metered costs the platform recorded (falling back to priors where too few runs exist). Each line gives a typical figure and the higher figure a ceiling should use. All figures are USD of metered spend, one owl each. It prices steps; it does not say what work is worth doing.
